a10e_P0_baseline_visual_only_v1.description: A10E P0 baseline equivalent to lvvis_visual_only_v1; kept as non-overwriting baseline inside A10E prompt search.
a10e_P0_baseline_visual_only_v1.system_prompt: You describe object categories for visual recognition. Use only observable visual attributes. Do not mention typical locations, usage, care, people, or co-occurring objects unless they are physically part of the object.

user_prompts.prompt: Describe the visual appearance of [CLS] in one concise sentence. Focus on shape, parts, material, texture, color, and distinctive visual cues.
user_prompts.source: current lvvis_visual_only_v1 baseline copied for A10E non-overwriting search

a10e_P0_baseline_visual_only_v1.feature_pooling: mean over generated assistant token hidden states per response; mean over prompt/repeat views per class; L2 normalize after view mean

a10e_P1_crop_morphology.description: Segmented-object-crop morphology prompt: suppress scene/context and describe visible crop attributes only.
a10e_P1_crop_morphology.system_prompt: You generate visual attribute phrases for object recognition from segmented object crops. Describe only visible appearance. Do not mention scene, location, function, usage, people, habitat, taxonomy, or co-occurring objects.

user_prompts.prompt: For [CLS], write 4 to 6 short visual attribute phrases only. Focus on silhouette, major parts, material, texture, color pattern, and distinctive visible cues. No full sentence.

a10e_P1_crop_morphology.feature_pooling: mean over generated assistant token hidden states per response; mean over prompt/repeat views per class; L2 normalize after view mean

a10e_metadata.target_hypothesis: increase DINO-compatible local object-crop kNN structure

a10e_P2_local_global.description: Local-global visual cues prompt: combine whole-object shape with patch-level texture and repeated local patterns.
a10e_P2_local_global.system_prompt: You describe object categories using only visual evidence that could be observed from image patches and an object crop. Ignore background, function, location, and semantic associations.

user_prompts.prompt: Describe [CLS] with compact visual cues: overall shape, contour, part layout, repeated local patterns, surface texture, material, and color distribution. Output short phrases only.

a10e_P2_local_global.feature_pooling: mean over generated assistant token hidden states per response; mean over prompt/repeat views per class; L2 normalize after view mean

a10e_metadata.target_hypothesis: match DINOv2 mixed global-object and local-patch structure

a10e_P3_discriminative.description: Fine-grained discriminative visual cues prompt: reduce full-vocabulary distractor suppression.
a10e_P3_discriminative.system_prompt: You create visual recognition cues that distinguish an object from visually similar categories. Use only observable appearance, never context, function, habitat, or co-occurring objects.

user_prompts.prompt: For [CLS], list the most discriminative visible cues: shape, part geometry, texture, material, color pattern, and details that separate it from similar-looking objects. Short phrases only.

a10e_P3_discriminative.feature_pooling: mean over generated assistant token hidden states per response; mean over prompt/repeat views per class; L2 normalize after view mean

a10e_metadata.target_hypothesis: improve full_available t2v ranking by reducing visually similar suppressors

a10e_P4_shape_first.description: Shape-first prompt: isolate silhouette, outline, aspect ratio, and part geometry.
a10e_P4_shape_first.system_prompt: You describe object categories by visible geometry only. Avoid function, scene, location, symbolic meaning, and co-occurrence.

user_prompts.prompt: For [CLS], describe only silhouette, outline, aspect ratio, main parts, part arrangement, and geometric details. Use short visual phrases.

a10e_P4_shape_first.feature_pooling: mean over generated assistant token hidden states per response; mean over prompt/repeat views per class; L2 normalize after view mean

a10e_metadata.target_hypothesis: test whether DINOv2 class manifold is primarily shape/geometry aligned

a10e_P5_texture_material.system_prompt: You describe only visible surface evidence for object recognition. Avoid context, usage, location, people, and associated objects.

user_prompts.prompt: For [CLS], describe material, surface texture, color pattern, markings, reflectance, and fine visual details. Use short phrases only.

a10e_P5_texture_material.feature_pooling: mean over generated assistant token hidden states per response; mean over prompt/repeat views per class; L2 normalize after view mean

a10e_metadata.target_hypothesis: test whether DINOv2 local-patch texture/material evidence improves alignment

a10e_P6_balanced_metric.description: Balanced metric prompt: fixed order of object-crop visual attributes for DINO-compatible self-supervised visual manifold alignment.
a10e_P6_balanced_metric.system_prompt: You produce compact visual feature descriptions for aligning language features to self-supervised vision features. Use only observable object appearance. Exclude scene, location, function, usage, people, habitat, taxonomy, and co-occurring objects.

user_prompts.prompt: For [CLS], output 5 compact visual phrases in this order: overall shape; part layout; material or surface; texture or color pattern; distinctive visual cue. Do not use field names.

a10e_P6_balanced_metric.feature_pooling: mean over generated assistant token hidden states per response; mean over prompt/repeat views per class; L2 normalize after view mean
